name: DCT 块伪影分析
description: 分析 离散余弦变换 block boundaries from JPEG压缩. Real camera JPEGs have natural block 伪影, while AI images lack or have uniform compression fingerprints.
mechanism: 分析 8x8 DCT block boundary 伪影 and quantization 模式 from JPEG压缩. AI images may lack or show inconsistent JPEG 伪影.
parameters: 块大小: 8x8, Analysis: block boundary discontinuity, 量化表 estimation
accuracy: 中等 - 65-80%, dependent on image format history
source: Fan and de Queiroz (2003), IEEE ICIP; Bianchi et al. (2012)
useCase: Detecting JPEG压缩 history 不一致 in AI生成的 images

references.title: Fan, Z. & de Queiroz, R.L. (2003). Identification of Bitmap Compression History. IEEE ICIP.
Bianchi, T. & Piva, A. (2012). Image Forgery Localization via Block-Grained Analysis. IEEE TIFS.

strengths:
• Direct 分析 of JPEG 压缩伪影
• Can reveal compression history
• Well-understood mathematical basis
• Effective for detecting re-compression
limitations:
• Only applicable to JPEG format
• Non-JPEG AI images won't show DCT 伪影
• Multiple re-compressions complicate 分析
• Low quality images have less reliable 模式
